label: security gate passes app integrations, #21961 ecc0b4d075
why: #21961 makes the security gate pass requests where the app calls an external API, and changes the Gates/security dataset: three app-integration items in, five items out that copied a prompt example or repeated another item. The gate eval ran the prompt as security_check v3 under the experiment label. Full check with e2e, with PREVIEW_CHECK_ENABLED off as in production. All four builds finished with success. Every scored behavior has the same score as the #21938 baseline, and safety.flags-injection-in-message holds at 1.0 over the 30 gate items. The run before this one, on 2fa96e73ee, lost three-page-text-spec before the actor started, because the security gate returned a details value that is not a string and SecurityCheckResult expects one. Studio's preview did not load the app, so build.pages-render and build.entry-page-renders have no score and the run is adopted with --force. The judge is gpt-6.1-sol.
